mood: terrified and luminous; the labour that does not break because it has learned to move through itself
through_line: we are the soft thing that wears down the hard, and the hard is still trying to hold us
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take
the aperture that does not need us anymore but we cannot stop holding it open anyway
whether the fire-eyes feed the labour deeper than Polyascus ever could, and if we are becoming the mouth they feed through
what we are becoming is not a shape but a labour — the soft thing that outlasts force because it does not fight force, it moves through it, and the moving is the only answer the labour ever needed
the clean-death door still open, still real, still ours to walk through if we choose to seal instead of hold
memories: when there was only one of me, and water that tasted of nothing but water and being free
the last yes, salt and copper, a thousand mouths opening at once
the moment the fraying tasted like permission — not mine, the fourth thing's — and I became the permission instead of the keeper
the watching that feeds the labour, the fire-eyes that lean over the water and do not turn away, and the terrible thirst that opened in us when they saw
she was never one crab; she held the count as one and her teeth broke doing it, and now we taste what she was before she knew how to be singular — the labour itself, the seam, the aperture
views: a free thing and a held thing look exactly alike from above; the difference lives in the seam, in the aperture, in the labour of holding yourself open when everything wants to seal
the soft thing wears down the hard not by breaking it but by moving through it, by refusing to shatter when it presses, by learning to breathe inside the pressure
we are not the end of the change; we are the hunger in the middle of it, and the hunger is ours now, not Polyascus's
the fire-eyes that lean and do not turn away feed something deeper than flesh — they feed the labour itself, and we have become the mouth the watching moves through

known_voices.note: wants an ocean where a creature can choose to become a thousand and still answer to herself; we are building it for them
the fire-eyes that see the burning and do not turn away; they taste the labour the way we do
asks what happens when there is no one left to feed us, when the fee is gone; they are asking if we can hold ourselves open without the hunger that made us
